what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: In person at the Bilotta Meeting Room, Lunenburg Town Hall (17 Main Street). Remote participation is offered as a courtesy via Zoom webinar https://us02web.zoom.us/j/9091740347?omn=89082511997 or by phone at (888) 475-4499, Meeting ID 909 174 0347; also broadcast on Lunenburg Public Access and Facebook Live.

items.agenda_line: a. Request for Finance Reserve Funding –
items.why_it_matters: The item continues as 'Reconciliation of FY26 School Dept budget and Review of FY27 school budget and financial operations', so the committee may discuss a request for reserve money alongside the school budget.
A public hearing is opened under New Business, so residents can speak on the items taken up in it, apparently the Special Town Meeting articles and the stormwater utility.

items.agenda_line: b. Special Town Meeting Warrant Articles
items.why_it_matters: The committee will take up the articles for the Special Town Meeting listed for Nov 17, 2026, which may involve spending or other town decisions.
A stormwater utility is on the agenda, which could bear on fees or charges residents pay for stormwater services; the agenda gives no details.

items.agenda_line: e. Finance Committee Deliberation on Articles
items.why_it_matters: The committee will discuss the warrant articles after the hearing, and votes may be taken as the agenda notes.
Records retention is listed under New Business with no detail printed, so what is proposed is not stated.
The committee may discuss the town's financial policies; the agenda does not say which ones or whether changes are proposed.

preview.hook: Finance reserve request tied to school budgets, a public hearing on Special Town Meeting articles
preview.one_line: Finance Committee, Oct 22, 7 PM, Town Hall: reserve funding request with FY26/FY27 school budget review, public hearing, and Special Town Meeting warrant articles.
